Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

We had some trouble at the family hotel this week. We were at capacity, a Finnish group and a British group had booked around 12 rooms between them. Near the bar, a fight broke out last night towards closing time. Someone from the Finnish group said something and a fight broke out from among them. It caused such a ruckus that it woke up the British group who had actually gone to bed. Who was just minding their own business?
A. The British group
B. the Finnish group
C. Can't answer
